- NW-1793 (Cloud Inference, $420k) — Stage: Proposal, Close Date: 2026-09-03 — no recent touches since 6/30.
- NW-1804 (Dedicated Capacity, $185k) — Stage: Negotiation, Close Date: 2026-08-28 — procurement indicated delayed in last call?
- NW-1810 (Proof-of-Value, $50k) — Stage: Evaluation, Close Date: 2026-08-20 — no activity in CRM.

Please do the following:
1) Reply with explicit status (Confirm / Push / Close / Archive) for each opp.
2) If pushing, add brief reason and proposed new close date.
3) Tag the record with the Finance label: Finance:Q3-verify and update expected ACV if changed.

Why this matters: Finance asked for a conservative commit list by EOD Monday; uncertain or unvalidated opps get counted as upside only. Small ask but big impact on how the quarter shapes up.

Thanks — will escalate to Vivek if we don't get confirmations.
